sections.description: Save posts and selected shop items by email, with optional consent-based newsletter signup.
sections.changelog:
= 0.5.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.5.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.5.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 0.3.1 =
* Fade popups and their backdrops in gently, respecting reduced-motion preferences.

= 0.3.0 =
* Save posts and selected items with a built-in form; keep WPForms as an optional compatibility mode.
* Edit field labels, newsletter defaults and branded success/error messages with a safe popup preview.
* Inherit theme Button styles and choose registered styles when available.
* Preserve input after errors, bound public submissions, and prevent duplicate delivery on retries.

= 0.2.6 =
* Choose newsletter providers from a compact logo list with Connect buttons and setup shown on demand.
* Keep editor drafts while activating an installed provider add-on, with clearer saved and pending states.

= 0.2.5 =
* Choose whether the newsletter checkbox starts selected in post and shop email forms. Readers can still uncheck it before submitting.
* Show smaller shop-item images beside their titles and shopping links.
* Use modern system sans-serif typography in emails and previews.
* Leave post and shop greetings blank by default; saved greetings remain editable.

= 0.2.4 =
* Use Save my picks for the selected-item email action and popup submit button.

= 0.2.3 =
* Offer Email my picks and Shop selected items with clear, editable action labels.
* Open one shared email popup with a live selected-item count and separate optional newsletter consent.
* Keep selections independent between checklists and provide individual links when a browser blocks shopping tabs.

= 0.2.2 =
* Organize settings into tabs with one Save changes action and preserve drafts between views.
* Preview post and shop emails in the delivery layout, with inline editing and desktop/mobile widths.
* Customize shop greetings, shopping links, post buttons and fallback text independently.
* Use Save to Email throughout the dashboard and block editor.

= 0.2.1 =
* Use “Save to Email” for all visible plugin, editor and settings labels.

= 0.2.0 =
* Move newsletter providers into optional shared Kit, Flodesk and Attentive add-ons.
* Show the selected provider and inactive add-on status while preserving saved account settings.
* Require the matching add-on for newsletter signup; saved email delivery continues independently.

= 0.1.0 =
* Save posts or selected shop items to email with images, titles and shopping links.
* Include optional newsletter signup, editable email branding and an accessible post-save popup.
* Keep creator settings, integrations and updates separate from the recipe Save to Email plugin.
